title: Animated FPS M4A4
author: JUST
changes: Retain the four original arm/hand meshes, 113-joint skin and Hide/Reload/Shoot/Take clips. Exclude M4A4 gun meshes, textures and display/camera nodes; retain the existing M4A1 gun. Normalize arm frame to meters; compact accessor data byte-exactly; resolution-preserving WebP with near-lossless q20 normals. One arm mesh/skeleton/texture set shared by M4 and AK; native AK palm/finger motions retargeted by anatomical hand frames. Redundant animation keys removed with retained key bytes and clip endpoints intact (local 0.01mm translation, 1e-5 scale, 1e-4 rad rotation limits). Runtime body-anchored connected arm IK, native hand/finger poses, magazine/bolt-catch contact adaptation and native-timed reload, full hide/draw and source rifle handling poses. Native firing/camera recoil excluded; existing gameplay aim/recoil authoritative. Source GLB preserved. v28 resolution-preserving second-stage q90 material/q92 color recompression per uploaded side-optics kit. Original uploads and historical first-stage derivatives retained.
